lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator's most vital life force, lost permanently upon use, causing irreversible damage to lifespan and cultivation base.
A legendary minor forbidden array that excels at illusion and concealment.
The second major cultivation stage, granting a substantial increase in power and lifespan.
A final, all-out confrontation between major forces, often used as a narrative device to force character resolutions.
